heading: Federal Government empowered to remove or destroy obstruction in fairway
title: Federal Government empowered to remove or destroy obstruction in fairway
text:
2. Federal Government empowered to remove or destroy obstruction in fairway.
Whenever, in any fairway leading to any port in Pakistan, any vessel is sunk, stranded or abandoned, or any fishing-stake, timber of other thing is placed or left, the 7Federal Government may, if in its opinion such thing is, or is likely to become, an obstruction or danger to navigation,-
(a) cause such thing or any part thereof to be removed; or
(b) if such thing is of such a description or so situate that, in the opinion of the 7Federal Government, it is not worth removing, cause the same or any part thereof to be destroyed.

heading: Federal Government entitled to expenses incurred in removing obstruction
title: Federal Government entitled to expenses incurred in removing obstruction
text:
3. Federal Government entitled to expenses incurred in removing obstruction. Whenever anything is removed under section 2, the 7Federal Government shall be entitled to receive a reasonable sum, having regard to all the circumstances of the case, for the expenses incurred in respect of such removal.
Dispute concerning such expenses. Any dispute arising concerning the amount due under this section, in respect of anything so removed, shall be decided by the District Magistrate 8* * * having jurisdiction at the place where such thing is, upon application to him for that purpose by either of the disputing parties; and such decision shall be final.

title: Things removed may, in certain cases, be sold
text: 5. Things removed may, in certain cases, be sold. heading: Proceeds how applied
title: Proceeds how applied
text:
6. Proceeds how applied. On realizing the proceeds of such sale, the amount due for expenses and charges as aforesaid, together with the expenses of the sale, shall be deducted therefrom, and the surplus (if any) shall be paid to the owner of the thing sold, or, if no such person appear and claim such surplus, shall be held in deposit for payment, without interest, to any person thereafter establishing his right to the same:
Provided that he makes the claim within one year from the date of the sale.

heading: Power to make rules to regulate and prohibit the placing of obstructions in fairways
title: Power to make rules to regulate and prohibit the placing of obstructions in fairways
text:
8. Power to make rules to regulate and prohibit the placing of obstructions in fairways.
The Federal Government may, from time to time, by notification in the official Gazette, make rules to regulate or prohibit, in any fairway leading to a port in Pakistan, the placing of fishingstakes, the casting or throwing of ballast, rubbish or any other thing likely to give rise to a bank or shoal, or the doing of any other act which will in its opinion, cause, or be likely to cause, obstruction or danger to navigation.

heading: Compensation payable in certain cases for damage caused under this Act
title: Compensation payable in certain cases for damage caused under this Act
text:
10. Compensation payable in certain cases for damage caused under this Act. Whenever the maintenance or creation of an obstruction in any fairway has become lawful by long usage or otherwise, and such obstruction is removed or destroyed under section 2, or its creation is regulated or prohibited under section 8, any person having a right to maintain or create such obstruction shall be entitled to receive from the Federal Government reasonable compensation for any damage caused to him by such removal, destruction, regulation or prohibition.
Every dispute arising concerning the right to such compensation, or the amount thereof, shall be determined according to the law for the time being in force relating to like disputes in the case of land needed for public purposes2 and not otherwise ; and for the purposes of such law the fairway from or in which such obstruction was removed or destroyed, or in which its creation was regulated or prohibited, shall be deemed to be a part of the 3* * * district in which the port to which such fairway leads is situated.

heading: Certain action of the Government previous to passing of this Act be deemed to have
title: Certain action of the Government previous to passing of this Act be deemed to have
text: 11. Certain action of the Government previous to passing of this Act be deemed to have been taken hereunder. Whenever any obstruction in a fairway leading to a port in Pakistan has been removed or destroyed, or whenever the creation of any such obstruction has been regulated or prohibited, by an order of the Federal Government or a Provincial Government, previous to the passing of this Act, such removal, destruction, regulation or prohibition shall be deemed to have been effected under this Act.
